name: Free Utility Lab new asset factory checklist
purpose: Make new assets repeatable without manual page cloning.

checks.label: Catalog entry
checks.description: Add a complete data/marketplace.json entry with id, slug, category, formats, outputs, schema_types, tracking_asset_id and live/planned status.

checks.label: Main product page
checks.description: Create the primary product HTML page at the catalog local_path with canonical metadata and shared assets.

checks.label: Category hub inclusion
checks.description: Confirm the asset appears in the relevant marketplace/category hub after catalog rendering.

checks.label: Real usable asset
checks.description: Ship at least one real tool, template, checklist, calculator, worksheet, planner, guide or comparison asset.

checks.label: Copy/print/export outputs
checks.description: Include practical outputs such as copy, CSV/download, print, PDF or checklist actions.

checks.label: Schema
checks.description: Add JSON-LD appropriate for the page, normally BreadcrumbList plus SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo or ItemList.

checks.label: Tracking
checks.description: Use the standardized measurement events and safe tracking_asset_id without forwarding private inputs.

checks.label: Internal links
checks.description: Link to relevant hubs and related tools with current /free-utility-lab/ base-path safe URLs.

checks.label: Validation pass
checks.description: Run python3 scripts/run_all_validations.py and the new-asset validator before publishing.

checks.label: No secrets
checks.description: Keep manifests, docs, scripts and generated pages credential-free.

checks.label: No thin support pages
checks.description: Do not publish thin support pages; every support page needs real utility content and internal links.
